a0_selected_tool_source.binding: DERIVED, not read verbatim: neither headroom.json (schema saea-a2t-a0-headroom-v1) nor verdict.json (schema saea-a2t-a0-read-v1) carries a per-sample selected-tool-name field -- both were checked and carry only sample_ids/per-tier aggregates. rails.probes.a2t_s2_flight.derive_a0_selected_tools re-reads attempt_dir/outputs.jsonl (via analysis.a2t_read.load_attempt_rows, reused) and parses each zero-supply row's response_text through reproduction.toolcall_scoring.parse_tool_calls_text (the committed scorer parser, the SAME one Audio2ToolAdapter.score calls) -- never gold, never a second parser.

execution_plan.note: planned_* are ceilings the plan is validated/metered against (contracts.ExecutionPlan); protocol_hash and run_id/attempt_id are assigned by the flying agent's own launcher at flight time, never frozen here. split_identity_hash is carried through for D2/ExecutionPlan identity even though this flight resolves its own sample set from headroom_manifest, not from a fresh Audio2ToolAdapter.load_split() draw.

bridge.note: Every S1p/S2/S4/N0r request sends supplied_evidence=[]/evidence_provenance=[] under this same fixed D2 arm -- the supply manipulation lives inside task_instruction (system message) text for every arm in this probe, S1p/S2/S4 included (bridge mission item 3: supply REPLACES {tool_schemas}, it is never an extra user-content text part), so FrozenCoreClient never has a rails 'text' content part to translate into a supplied_evidence item, exactly like A0's own zero-supply request.

arm_semantics.S1p: self-supplied single roster: the registry row(s) of the tool(s) the core ITSELF named in its own A0 response for that sample (n=120). Exactly 1 row for the ~75/120 single-intent-tier samples; >1 row only for the tier3/tier8 multi-intent minority.
arm_semantics.S2: diluted: correct tool row(s) + seeded distractor rows, TOTAL roster size fixed at 9 (prereg 'K=9' read literally as a total dose, not 9 distractors on top of the correct row) (n=120)
arm_semantics.S4: deranged: exactly ONE wrong tool's row, from a fixed-point-free seeded (Sattolo-cycle) mapping over the distinct tool identities the 120 samples' own A0 selections cover (n=120)
arm_semantics.N0r: noise-floor arm: zero-supply re-fly of 40 seeded, tier-proportional samples of the 120 -- byte-identical request shape to A0 (Audio2ToolAdapter.assemble_prompt(sample, None) reused unchanged, full 152-row registry, no extra content part) (n=40)

supply_shape.note: Bridge mission item 3: for S1p/S2/S4 the system prompt's {tool_schemas} fill is REPLACED by the arm's own narrowed roster -- the full 152-row registry IS the A0/N0r condition, never re-sent alongside a narrowed one. The rest of the instruction template (rails.adapters.audio2tool._INSTRUCTION_TEMPLATE) is byte-identical across every arm.
supply_shape.s1p_entries: 1 (typical; multi-intent tier3/tier8 minority may carry more, one row per distinct selected tool)
supply_shape.token_estimate_basis: A0's own measured full-152-row prefill: ~12693 tokens (pa2t-binding.json A0_shipped_supply_measurements); a single registry row averages ~330 chars (per_tool_line_chars_mean 329.9) so S1p/S4's single-row prompts are two orders of magnitude below A0's prefill, S2's 9-row prompt roughly an order of magnitude below -- exact per-arm counts are computed by rails.probes.a2t_s2_flight.roster_supply_packet's own SupplyDose.token_count (whitespace-split estimate, the SAME convention rails.probes.pslu_flight._roster_packet already uses) and reported at flight-plan build time, not hardcoded here.

n0r.selection_rule: tier-proportional largest-remainder (Hare quota) apportionment of 40 across the 120 headroom ids' own tiers, ties among equal remainders broken by a seeded shuffle (never an arbitrary tier-name order), then a seeded per-tier draw without replacement -- rails.probes.a2t_s2_flight.n0r_seeded_draw. Fully reproducible from (headroom_ids, seed, target_n) alone.

cost_budget.basis: preregistration section 6: A0 measured ~10.5 req/min with registry prefix-cache reuse; 400 requests approx 40 min + margin. S1p/S2/S4's narrowed registry text breaks the SAME prefix-cache A0/N0r's full-152-row system prompt shares, so no per-arm prefill cache reuse is assumed across arms in this ceiling.

branch_rules_source: docs/readiness/2026-08-18-pa2t-stage2-preregistration-REGISTERED.md section 4 (VOID / COPY-TRAP / SCHEMA-ONLY / SUPPLY-CONVERTS / INERT / DOSE point) -- mechanical from the per-sample outputs.jsonl rows this flight produces; branch evaluation itself is NOT implemented by this engineering mission (a separately-registered, pinned read suite extending analysis.a2t_read is a later task, built and reviewed BEFORE the one-shot read per the preregistration's own discipline section).
